text: [L1-L5] (HIGH/shell-line-endings) CRLF endings break direct Unix execution and append carriage returns to the rsa key-type argument and remote hostname under Bash.
[L3,L5] (MED/key-selection-contract) ssh-keygen lets the user choose a key filename but ssh-copy-id always installs id_rsa.pub, potentially copying a different existing key.
[L6-L12] (MED/destructive-input-validation) The recursive deletion root comes from unchecked %1, so an omitted argument targets drive-root dist directories instead of a validated solution directory.

[L21-L37,L59,L74] (HIGH/command-quoting) Older-version branches store quotes inside devenv_path and the invocation adds another pair, producing malformed executable quoting for paths containing spaces.

[L780,L862-L873] (MED/backup-error-handling) Backup creation and restoration are unchecked and the backup is deleted even after a failed restore, undermining protection against clobbering COPYING or INSTALL.
[L1-L39] (HIGH/shell-line-endings) CRLF line endings invalidate the Unix shebang and introduce literal carriage returns into Bash commands and variable values.
[L14-L38] (HIGH/build-failure-propagation) Failed dependency loading, configuration, compilation or installation does not prevent subsequent module publication.
[L27] (MED/scientific-compiler-semantics) Unconditional -ffast-math allows finite-value assumptions and numerical transformations that can compromise NaN diagnostics and change scientific results.
